name: Posui Lengjing
source:
A sudden downpour shattered the planet’s tranquil routine.

Twisted, monstrous fission creatures began to run rampant.
Those who gained extraordinary powers to counter them were called:
"Phelimatiya."

Beneath the lighthouse stretched a mysterious black ocean, shimmering like polished ore.
At its center stood an island-like sanctuary:
[Black Reef.]
Latitude 64°09' N, Longitude 21°56' W.

Following the tides, they sought the rewritten truths of the world.

"Welcome to
our world."

—BROKEN PRISM

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3116370/_Broken_Prism/]steam[/url]]
